say:1:1033106001:1.text: Very soon. We're just waiting for everyone to finish packing up, then we'll move to the camp the Wilders marked for us.
say:1:1033106001:1.source_cn: 很快的，等大家把这里的东西收拾一下，就搬到绿裔成员划给...
say:1:1033106001:1.male: Very soon. We're just waiting for everyone to finish packing up, then we'll move to the camp the Wilders marked for us.
say:1:1033106001:1.female: Very soon. We're just waiting for everyone to finish packing up, then we'll move to the camp the Wilders marked for us.

say:2:1033106002:1.text: We're also waiting on some others to finish packing, then we'll hit the road together.
say:2:1033106002:1.source_cn: 而且我们也得等其他人收拾完，一起上路呢。
say:2:1033106002:1.male: We're also waiting on some others to finish packing, then we'll hit the road together.
say:2:1033106002:1.female: We're also waiting on some others to finish packing, then we'll hit the road together.

say:3:1033106003:1.text: Even though Patrick's already recovered, he still can't carry too much. Luckily, everyone's willing to help us; otherwise, I don't know how we'd get there.
say:3:1033106003:1.source_cn: 小派瑞克虽然已经恢复了健康，但也拿不了太多东西，还好大...
say:3:1033106003:1.male: Even though Patrick's already recovered, he still can't carry too much. Luckily, everyone's willing to help us; otherwise, I don't know how we'd get there.
say:3:1033106003:1.female: Even though Patrick's already recovered, he still can't carry too much. Luckily, everyone's willing to help us; otherwise, I don't know how we'd get there.

say:4:1033106004:1.text: I've been looking after him so much that I've barely slept in days. It's good to have a bit of a rest.
say:4:1033106004:1.source_cn: 为了照顾他，我也好几天没睡过好觉了，多休息一会儿也好。
say:4:1033106004:1.male: I've been looking after him so much that I've barely slept in days. It's good to have a bit of a rest.
say:4:1033106004:1.female: I've been looking after him so much that I've barely slept in days. It's good to have a bit of a rest.

say:5:1033106005:1.text: I wonder what our new home is going to be like.
say:5:1033106005:1.source_cn: 不知道以后生活的地方会是什么样呢？
say:5:1033106005:1.male: I wonder what our new home is going to be like.
say:5:1033106005:1.female: I wonder what our new home is going to be like.
